Proposition clause 1 gives exactly the F1 matrix equivalence for maps. The four examples concern linear invertible maps: scaling has inverse (q,p)->(q/lambda,lambda*p), the shear inverse subtracts q1 from q2, and a block satisfying A_i^T J2 A_i=J2 has inverse -J2 A_i^T J2. Direct matrix multiplication and the alternating four-linear determinant argument establish all claims.
